content.short: Transit Swap is a multichain swap and bridge aggregator that helps users move assets across TON and other networks.
content.description: Transit Swap is a cross-chain swap and decentralized exchange platform that enables real-time, trustless asset swaps across multiple networks. It integrates liquidity from a wide set of DEXs and aggregates quotes from several sources, helping users find favorable rates without leaving the platform. The Transit Swap API returns up-to-date price quotes for token swaps on all supported networks. Liquidity is sourced from top DEXs such as Uniswap, Sushi, PancakeSwap, and more across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, and beyond.
content.meta: Transit Swap is a cross-chain swap and DEX platform. Discover its TON DeFi role, main workflow, and related apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
